violated_contract: A value an operator changed in production to resolve an incident (a Cloud Tasks queue rate, a queue re-point) must be declared in reviewed config that every deploy reads; a deploy action must never re-assert an older literal over it. On 2026-10-19 the 07:07Z train reset batch-quarantine-recovery from the 01:27Z 16/8 back to the action literal 4/4, recovery backed up (quarantine to projection p95 383s, later 1,285s) and the 5% record-lane re-qualification failed; the same train re-pointed backend-sync-backfill at the sync-backfill queue retired after the 04:52Z stall.
canonical_prevention: Declare operator-owned values in the runtime manifest or the B4 ops file and have deploy actions read them, keeping a hard-coded value only as the default when nothing is declared. Until the ops file reaches main, any remaining action literal must equal the live operator value and be pinned by a contract test that names the incident.
